messages:
jamal: Big news — we just signed our first Dedicated contract with Zephyr Health 🎉🥯
sophia: WHAT!! 🚀 congrats team!!!
kevin: omg bagels in the kitchen at 11am? i volunteer to man the cream cheese station :raised_hands:
lee: can we get some vegan options? and maybe a mini kazoo for noise compliance 😂
ashley: congrats!! any details we can share on #sales? (don’t need customer PII, just hype)
maria: Zephyr is starting with a 6-month reserved pool. This is the win we were running toward — so proud. :heart:
ops-bot: Canary rollouts for Zephyr Dedicated completed: 3/3 regions, no errors, final validation passed ✅
kevin: i’ll bring a playlist. voting poll: everything bagel vs cinnamon raisin vs vegan avocado toast?
jamal: vote with emoji — :bagel: = everything, :apple: = cinnamon, :avocado: = vegan
sophia: :bagel: 
maria: :avocado: (remote cheers from the east coast) 
lee: :bagel: +1
ashley: :apple: fatefully allergic to sesame but will eat cake instead
jamal: also ordered a tiny supply of Zephyr-branded stickers & mini stress corgis for the kitchen desk raffle — shoutout to ops for the quick turnaround
ashley: omg corgis :corgi_face: 
kevin: is it weird that the first thing i think about for a big contract is snacks and stickers? no, it’s not. :party_parrot:
sophia: not weird, extremely normal. we celebrate the wins the redwood way 🥳
jamal: remote folks — we’ll mail stickers and a small care package. dm me your address if you want one.
lee: congrats again team. small moment, huge momentum.
maria: could someone quickly drop a one-liner for the internal all-hands slide? i can polish it.
kevin: "Closed Zephyr Health — first Dedicated contract; 6-month reserved capacity. Team unlocked: bagels + corgis." feel free to tweak
sophia: love it. :thumbsup:
jamal: ok slide drafted, bagels at 11, stickers raffle at 11:30. see you there (and on Zoom for remote cheers)! :tada:
